title: S71 later notes: doctor registry line, sh prefix strip, time, no-projects line

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Later notes from the S71 relay (run-20261026-220333-446b, landed 3a0a54a), ork doctor. Owner decision 2026-10-29 (interactive): fix all four. UI pass (internal/cli output).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestDoctorRegistryErrorDoesNotRepeatTheWord (no 'registry registry'); TestDoctorShellErrorPrefixStopsAtTheFirstMarker (a message containing 'sh: ' keeps its tail); TestDoctorTimeIsOnTheShellWordSkipList ('time go test' does not warn without /usr/bin/time); TestDoctorShowsNoneRegisteredForAnEmptyRegistry ('[--] projects  none registered').

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Tests first; re-anchor line numbers from the code. 1. registry.Load prefixes parse and validation errors with 'registry PATH:' (registry.go ~141-162) but not read errors (~134-135): make the doctor text line not repeat 'registry' (trim in the text branch near doctor.go ~381 or make Load consistent; pick the smaller change and keep other callers' messages). 2. Make shellErrorPrefix (doctor.go ~126) non-greedy so only the leading shell prefix is cut. 3. Add 'time' to the shell-word skip list. 4. With an empty or missing registry print '[--] projects  none registered' so it differs from 'projects not checked'. Docs: dashboard.md or design.md wherever doctor output is shown. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race -count=1 ./...; go vet ./...; gofmt -l .; slicer check; adj lint.
